comment: Expert study task 2 (docs/knowledge/testing/expert-study.md). Parser grammar of tools/activity_log/parse_activity_log.py only. Analyse only the log portion recorded in this task's project (tools/expert_study/split_activity_log.py). Completion of every predicate does not imply a correct model: grade.py is authoritative. Gaps: metavariable definitions, $lua values (scale, classifier, Q/K/V out_features) and the join are not observable; node scope is not matchable; handles are not matchable.

tasks.title: T2 Embedding width is $d-model
tasks.comment: Metavariable definitions themselves (d-model, num-heads) are not observable: metavariables.set logs the JSON as one string, which event data matching compares exactly. A $ref in a parameter is only accepted when the metavariable exists, so usage implies it.

tasks.title: T2 Classifier input no longer literal 896
tasks.comment: Approximation: parameter values that are $lua expressions cannot be matched, so this only checks that no Linear(896,10) remains while a Linear with out_features 10 exists.

tasks.title: T2 Horizontal Repeat times is $num-heads
tasks.comment: The join stereotype (Concat, dim -1) is not checked: nested join parameters are not matchable; grade.py checks head concatenation behaviourally.
